scenarios.name: Dismiss Docking Positions from the expanded Constrain title menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional command area is open
the user right-clicks the lower Constrain title
the title context menu offers Ribbon Appearance, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions
the Constrain additional command area remains open
Top is checked and Left and Right are available
the Docking Positions submenu closes and the title context menu remains open
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the title context menu and Constrain additional command area close
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
